lessons.claim: tools/postmortem.py judged every observable carrying a prediction against a flat 5 %, ignoring both the  and the declared tol_pct/tol_sigma that bdbot/metrics.py writes beside it -- so a hypothesis mismatch (a RESULT under rule 7') and a measurement with a reference value both became WRONG_REGIME, and an implementation_check inside its own 20 % band was called a mismatch at -10 %. Measured on 8 sedimentation runs: 4 recorded OUTCOME: FAILURE while the only real gate passed on all 8, written into record.json which is the permanent record. It had been this way for every case.
